messages:
maria: Heads-up — we just received a security questionnaire from Lumina Health (CAIQ + a 6‑page custom addendum). They're asking for data residency, KMS/BYOK, SOC reports, and deployment options. Due EOW. Link: https://files.lumina.example/lumina-sig-2026.pdf

ajay: Assigning to me for initial triage. Can sales paste the POC target topology (cloud vs private) and contact for DPA/Privacy?

maria: POC is scheduled Fri 3pm PST. Customer leaning to private (VPC) but wants pricing options. Contact is emma@lumina.health. They specifically asked about HSM-backed keys and on-prem package.

kevin: Added to the intake tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-2798 — status=needs-triage. I'll attach the questionnaire PDF.

ajay: Quick triage notes: Q18 (pentest cadence) — we answer "annual + as-needed for Dedicated/Private". Q27 (subprocessors) — need list of subprocessors from legal. Q5 (data residency) — confirm regions and whether logs are stored.

liz: @maria please share any customer-required subprocessors and whether they'd require a custom DPA. I can prepare a DPA addendum template once I have the subprocessors list.

maria: Will ask emma and share. For POC they'd like us to demonstrate VPC peering + optional B.Y.O.K. via KMS.

security-bot: SEC-Triage created SEC-2798 (owner: ajay) — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-2798

ajay: Drafting preliminary CAIQ answers. Pasting reusable snippet below for KMS question to speed sales QA: 

```
KMS/BYOK: Redwood supports customer-managed keys via standard KMS integrations and HSM-backed key storage for Dedicated and Private deployments. For hosted API, we support encrypted-at-rest with managed keys; BYOK can be enabled on Dedicated/Private with contract addendum. See: https://docs.redwood.ai/security/kms
```

ajay: Also flagging one potential blocker: on-prem package currently requires security signoff from eng-runtime for air-gapped verification. If Lumina requests on-prem air-gapped deployment we should loop in @eng-runtime early.

maria: Thanks — timeline: ajay fill preliminary responses by Thu EOD, liz to review DPA language after we get subprocessors, kevin keep tracker updated, sales to confirm POC config with customer. I'll post any updates after Fri call.

kevin: Noted. I set due date: 2026-04-02, priority=high.

ajay: I'll post the filled CAIQ answers in the ticket and drop a short summary here when done. If any technical clarifications come up during the POC, I'll escalate to eng-runtime.

liz: :thumbsup: Sounds good.

maria: One more: customer asked for SOC2 cert copy. I have the link to our certs page but will need a signed NDA before sharing some artifacts. Emily (Lumina) is okay with that step.

ajay: Put the cert link in the ticket and mark as "requires NDA".

maria: Will do. Thanks team.
